title: Power drill
prompt: A labelled teaching cutaway of the page 66 electric power drill is held in an external bench guide above a wood block. Start drives the motor, shaft-mounted cooling fan, gearing, spindle, chuck and bit. Drill uses an external feed hand to lower the rotating cutting end while chips move outward along the flutes. Withdraw lifts the drill clear and stops the motor. Show the pictured two-speed gearing without inventing an electronic controller or hammer mechanism. The guide and wood block are teaching fixtures.
blurb: An enlarged teaching cutaway shows a corded drill with mechanical two-speed gearing, an external feed hand and bench guide cutting a wood specimen.
truthNotes: The supplied 2016 page 66 image was inspected. The accepted brief also records direct 1998 support; 1988 remains inaccessible and unverified.
The guide, external feed hand and wood specimen are declared teaching apparatus. Internal proportions and gear detail are enlarged for legibility.
The shaft-mounted fan and input pinion rotate with the motor. Two mechanical ratios select spindle speed. No electronic controller, reverse or hammer mechanism is included.
Withdraw lifts the drill axially while it rotates and then stops the motor. The hole and removed wood remain.
